messages:
sam: quick heads up — nova13b-int4 qbringup shows a regression on our long-context promptset. precision@1k tokens down ~8pt vs float baseline. need promptset curation + labeling triage. @vikram, do you have bandwidth?

vikram: can you paste the eval snippet? is the drop across qa/summaries/rerank or localized?

sam: here's the smoke excerpt:
```
model,n_tokens,precision@1k
nova13b-fp32,1200,0.72
nova13b-int4,1200,0.64
nova13b-int8,1200,0.71
```
Drop seems concentrated in >1024 token examples, mostly longform summarization prompts.

marta: sounds like we should split the promptset into short/long/very-long, run dedupe + fingerprinting on the long bucket. i'll take dedupe + sample extraction.

marco: adding that quant kernel selection sometimes flushes KV cache differently for >1024, so could be runtime. also recommend creating a micro-golden for longform to catch these regressions early.

sam: @label-bot please create labeling batch `longform-golden-review` size=500 priority=P1 assign to @marta

label-bot: Created LBL-2034 'longform-golden-review' size=500 priority=P1 assignees=[marta] ETA=3d

vikram: marta can you run dedupe and produce a 5k sample for the smoke eval? include % with >1024 tokens so we can quantify impact.

marta: on it. query i'll run:
```
SELECT id, array_length(tokens) as tkn
FROM prompts
WHERE array_length(tokens) > 1024
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 5000;
```
I'll push sample to s3://redwood-curation/longform_sample.tar.gz by EOD.

sam: great. also let's freeze the canary route for longform: nova13b-int4 should fallback to nova13b-int8 until golden pass. @marco can you set a routing policy in staging?

marco: done — added staging route: `route.longform = ["nova13b-int8","nova13b-int4"]` with latency-first fallback. will promote after smoke. ETA ~1h.

vikram: let's run a 200-case smoke eval from the golden once sample is labeled. compare precision@1k + ROUGE and post results here.

marta: sample uploaded to https://s3.redwood/curation/longform_sample.tar.gz — labeling pool created.

label-bot: LBL-2034 status: sample uploaded by marta. labeling pool size=60 workers. task queued.

sam: TL;DR action items: marta = dedupe + push sample, marco = routing change, label-bot = manage batch, vikram = run smoke eval. if dedupe rate >30% we tighten near-dup filter to 0.92 sim. :thumbsup:

vikram: noted — will post smoke eval results in this thread when ready.

marta: will post dedupe metrics & first 200 labeled examples here when available.
